title: Tenet
description: A non-binding, human-authored belief that guides decisions (e.g. API-first, prefer managed services). Informs one or more Guardrails; enforces nothing on its own. Renamed from Principle in v0.4.0 (ADR-0004 D3). Catalog: technehub-labs/dea-catalog-tenets.

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

statement.description: The canonical tenet statement (imperative or declarative).
examples: All services shall expose their capabilities via a well-defined API before any other integration mechanism.

rationale.description: Why this tenet exists — the benefit it secures.

applicability.description: Scope: which layers, domains, or entity types this tenet guides.

tier.description: Emphasis level of the belief. Tenets are always non-binding — enforcement lives on the Guardrails they inform (ADR-0004 D3).
